intended_appearance.reflections: Broad softened reflections, without sharp mirror images.
intended_appearance.contrast: Even gold face shading with brighter bevels and darker side walls.
intended_appearance.edges: Crisp serif and check outlines with softly beveled transitions.

gloss_intent.instructions: Does the surface sheen of `surface_to_inspect` in `candidate` match `intended_appearance.sheen`?

criteria.true: The visible surface sheen follows the stated treatment direction.
criteria.false: The visible surface sheen contradicts the stated treatment direction.
